title: OX Alpha launches on Open Router with high context and unknown #OXAlpha #OpenRouter #aitechnology
description: OX Alpha surfaced on Open Router as a mysterious new model with Fable-level coding capabilities and a million tokens of context. Despite no official parameter details or benchmarks, early tests show it outperforms Fable, marking a potentially significant advancement in open-source AI coding tools. Its free availability for a limited time encourages developers to experiment with large context tasks, highlighting a broader trend toward models capable of handling extensive codebases. The caveat is that prompts and completions are retained by the provider, limiting use to side projects rather than proprietary client code. This development reflects pressure-testing typical before major AI launches and underscores the evolving landscape of accessible, powerful coding assistants in AI communities. #OXAlpha #OpenRouter #AIcoding #FableAI #DeepSWE #StealthAI #LargeContextAI #OpenSourceAI #AImodels #CodeAI #AILaunch #AIbenchmarks #AIinnovation #CodingAI #AIDevelopment
